thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert: spike in 500s for /v1/generate. Initial signal from canary rollout of release/2026-03-db-migrate at 09:23 UTC. Errors look like SQL schema mismatch. Paging oncall.
oncall-eng: seeing it, investigating. canary finished green earlier, any post-canary migrations run? :thinking_face:
mike.h: I kicked off a backward-incompatible migration as part of the deploy — it was supposed to be gated by feature flag, but the flag eval had a bug. Reverting now.
lee: logs show exceptions: "ERROR: column \"user_context\" does not exist" from app-worker-12
diana: same from reranker pods. Traffic hit dedicated pool after auto-scale; many pods hit the new code path.
sre-lead: Triage steps: 1) flip kill-switch flag to disable new code path 2) stop rollout 3) assess DB migration state 4) rollback release if required. Anyone able to flip the flag now?
mike.h: flipping feature flag `enable_new_user_context` to false. `/flags set enable_new_user_context=false --env prod` -> running
incident-bot: Flag update recorded by opsbot at 09:36 UTC. Re-evaluating traffic.
lee: after flag flip error rate dropped ~70% on canary region but still present in some pods. Some migrations already partially applied (alter table started, created temp col but not populated).
db-admin-bot: Migration job 20260315_add_user_context is `stuck` on replica db-02; pid 2345 waiting on lock from long-running transaction.
diana: killing migration job on replica seems risky — can we cancel and resume? what's the runbook say?
sre-lead: follow DB-runbook -> safe-cancel, rollback side-effects. @mike.h coordinate with DB team. We need a quick customer impact assessment: product-ops, any signals on customer-facing errors or SLA breaches?
product-ops: Several paying customers reported degraded embeddings response times and a handful of 500s. No data loss reported yet. CS is patching SLOs and notifying top 5 customers.
mike.h: I can roll back the app image to previous revision for affected pools; but schema change may still block new code if any pods still on new image.
lee: I'm going to stop the deploy pipeline (pausing canary -> no new pods with new image). Pause done.
db-admin-bot: Current DB locks: tx 98765 on db-02 held by migration process; waiting queries piling on replicas. Suggest promoting failover? high risk.
sre-lead: don't failover yet. Option A: kill migration process and run compensating query to remove temp column. Option B: let migration finish after draining traffic — risky for latency. Which is faster?
mike.h: I will kill the migration job on db-02 and run the compensating SQL to drop temp column. Posting commands:
```
-- kill migration process
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(2345);
-- cleanup
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS user_context_tmp;
```
lee: Doing terminate now.
incident-bot: pg_terminate_backend(2345) -> success at 09:54 UTC. Cleanup `ALTER TABLE` queued.
db-admin-bot: Cleanup executed on replica; replica lag cleared. Master had no temp column; full cluster consistent.
diana: app errors down to baseline on all regions. Rolling back app images still scheduled to be safe — mike, do rollback now?
mike.h: Rolling back release/2026-03-db-migrate -> deployed previous image to affected pools at 10:12 UTC. Canary becomes stable.
product-ops: Customer impact summary: 9 customers saw increased latency; 2 saw request errors >0.5%. No persisted data corruption found. CS notifications sent.
sre-lead: Post-incident actions: 1) patch feature flag evaluation to prevent cross-env leakage 2) add pre-deploy migration dry-run + lock-awareness 3) update runbook with abort-vs-wait decision tree 4) schedule postmortem blameless write-up. Assigning owners: mike.h -> feature flag fix, lee -> runbook update, db-admin-bot (DB team) -> migration tooling improvements.
mike.h: reopening PR for flag gating fix. ETA EOD today.
diana: I'll start the postmortem doc and include timelines + customer comms draft.
incident-bot: Incident resolved 10:20 UTC. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
